scope: Pre-registered all-six-video x three-seed native FIFO replay for the learned local spatial-attention identity route. This closes a direct fine-grained local-evidence candidate only; it does not claim raw end-to-end FPS or final-goal completion before the gate is evaluated.

rule.description: Promote to strict raw whole-video validation only if local-attention FIFO improves both HOTA and IDF1 over the paired frozen FIFO reference in at least four of six videos, has positive macro deltas for both metrics, and does not increase macro IDSW.

finding: The learned local-attention route improves both HOTA and IDF1 only on BT-003 and MSK-002. BT-001 loses IDF1, SN-001 and SN-015 lose both metrics, and the six-video macro is negative for HOTA, AssA and IDF1 with a small macro IDSW increase. The preregistered promotion gate therefore fails.
next_boundary: Do not run strict raw local-attention or tune memory/thresholds from this result; require a separately registered independent signal before another combination.
